title: Regulator control catalog
description: Schema for .claude/skills/regulatory-catalogs/references/catalogs/<instrumentId>.catalog.json: an OSCAL 1.1.3 catalog reduced to what Maxwell workflows consume. groups mirror OSCAL groups, controls mirror OSCAL controls with prose and guidance parts flattened, mappings are regulatoryRefs to equivalent controls in other instruments. Control ids must be unique within a group; soc control records are keyed '<instrumentId>:<control id>' and regulatoryRefs cite (instrumentId, control id)

groups.title: Govern: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management

controls.title: Software Bill of Materials for critical systems
controls.prose: REs shall obtain a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for all critical systems and for every new critical software procured, listing components, versions, licences and known vulnerabilities, and shall keep it updated on every release
controls.guidance: Generate CycloneDX or SPDX from the build pipeline and store the reference under applications/<app_id>/images/<image_id>.cdx.json
evidenceExpected: Pipeline step that regenerates SBOM on release

params.label: SBOM format accepted for critical systems

instrumentId.description: Instrument this catalog was extracted from; must equal the file's basename before .catalog.json

regulator.description: Issuing regulator, copied from the instruments registry

version.description: Instrument version the catalog reflects, as in the instruments registry

sourceUrl.description: URL of the document the controls were extracted from

retrievedAt.description: When the source document was fetched for extraction

groups.description: OSCAL groups: chapters, functions or annexes of the instrument, each holding controls

id.description: Group identifier as the instrument numbers it, e.g. 'GV.SC', 'Annex-I', 'Chapter-IV'

title.description: Group heading as printed in the instrument

controls.description: Controls in this group; ids must be unique within the group

control.description: One control of the instrument. mandatory controls must state defaultSeverity, the severity a finding against the control gets when no CVSS score applies

id.description: Control id exactly as the instrument numbers it. regulatoryRefs cite it with the instrumentId; the soc ledger keys the control record '<instrumentId>:<id>'

title.description: Short control heading; write one if the instrument has none

prose.description: OSCAL statement part: the requirement text verbatim or a faithful paraphrase

guidance.description: OSCAL guidance part: how to implement or evidence the control in a typical Indian fin-serv stack

category.description: Framework category or domain the control belongs to, e.g. 'GV.SC', 'Access Control'

applicability.description: Narrows the instrument-level applicability for this control; omit when the whole instrument applies

reCategories.description: Regulator-defined tiers the control binds, as slugs shared with company details.regulatoryRegistrations[].category (e.g. 'qualified-re'); empty means all tiers

entityTypes.description: Entity types the control binds; empty means every type the instrument covers

mandatory.description: true when the instrument uses 'shall' or equivalent; false for guidance and recommendations

defaultSeverity.description: Severity a finding against this control carries when no CVSS score applies (soc finding.severity copies it); required for mandatory controls. Set from how the regulator weights the clause, not from intuition

cadence.description: How often the control must be performed or re-evidenced; 'event-driven' for controls triggered by a change or incident

slaDays.description: Days allowed to remediate a gap against this control only when the instrument itself states one (cite the clause in guidance); omit otherwise, the SLA table sets the deadline by severity

evidenceExpected.description: Artefacts an auditor would accept as proof the control operates

params.description: OSCAL params the control exposes: the parameter names a soc control record may set (record parameters[].name must be one of these ids) with the regulator-stated default, e.g. CSCRF password length or log retention days

id.description: Parameter name, camelCase, the same shape as soc control record parameters[].name

label.description: What the parameter sets, in the regulator's words

default.description: Regulator-stated default or minimum as text, when the clause states one; omit otherwise

mappings.description: Equivalent controls in other instruments (crosswalk); never map to the same instrument

probeWorkflows.description: Maxwell workflows whose observations can evidence this control
